highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.2 updates the m151 engine revision and separates its HarfBuzzSharp package revision line.

bullets.detail: Incorporates the upstream m151 servicing sync without managed API changes.
Uses HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.102 to avoid package-version collisions with independently serviced Skia milestones. Native HarfBuzz remains 14.2.1.
